sentence: Butt hinge: two leaves, knuckles, pin, clearance certified through the swing
design_notes: Swing 0-120 deg (leaf B rotated about the pin axis from flat open). Leaves 25 x 2 centred on the pin axis, with knuckle OD 6 and 3.2 pin bore, 4 knuckles of 9.6 with 0.4 axial gaps, 0.4 radial relief cut around the mating knuckles; pin 3.0. Swing sampled by rotating leaf B about the pin axis.
